notes.full427: Both fixed photographs have visibly less grain than V66. Fabric cords remain missing, and sky/facade retain grain; exact synthetic GT is much cleaner.
notes.known: Plates/shadows and the white-green-black panel show substantially less grain than V66, but colored grain remains and AHD is smoother. AHD is an independently demosaiced auxiliary reference, not exact RGB GT.
notes.unseen: Apple and tan/red surfaces have substantially less noise than V66, while colored grain/coarse variation persists. Independently demosaiced AHD is not exact RGB GT.
notes.analytic: Noise falls substantially, but weak carrier contrast is much fainter than GT. The high-noise dark period8 carrier is strongly suppressed; the midtone period16 carrier remains faint. Flat residual grain/coarse variation remains. Interpret gain and unrelated residual energy together.
notes.gfx: All four full-frame-derived ROIs show less noise than V66, yet sky remains grainy and noise/softness obscure truss and leaves. Fence mesh remains visible with more contrast than the GALOSH pilot but still noisy and below the separate low-ISO reference. ISO100 aperture/time/motion differ; not GT.
notes.three-camera: Q2 dark rocks are smoothed with less grain; Sony fuselage/window seams remain soft. GFX50R granular concrete texture remains and RawNIND is smoother. With no exact GT these six contexts do not establish a decisive advantage or distinguish all texture from noise.
notes.colored-CPU: Neutral/orange/magenta/cyan triplets show much less noise than V66, but coarse color variation remains, especially magenta/orange. Means alone are insufficient to establish restoration quality.
notes.hue-grid: Gray/orange/magenta triplets show substantially less grain than V66, yet residual coarse variation persists. Camera-channel mean bias increases versus V66 while overall RMSE decreases; it is not unbiased noisy-field restoration.
